title: feat(connector-mcp): a stdio MCP server takes its credential from the secrets layer through transport.credentialEnv
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95wDB21nUbCmU5szPePATGS)_ Fixes #29434 domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRFhrJgbwLP5mvZkeJ Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: added Skills-docs: follow-up #29625 — skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md recipe 6 still says a stdio server's credentials ride `transport.env`; `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` is updated here. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：`mcp` 连接器的 stdio 服务器现在可以从密钥层拿凭据。连接器照常声明 `auth: { type, credentialRef }`,再在 `providerConfig.transport.credentialEnv` 写上服务器读取的环境变量名，平台解析出的密钥只放进子进程的环境变量。 - 为什么改：以前 stdio 服务器的 API key 只能以明文写在 `transport.env` 里，存在元数据中;#29341 的提示也只能劝作者改用 http。 - 风险与回滚：只是新增一个作者可写的可选键(Metadata-protocol: added,connector-mcp 升 minor),没写 `credentialEnv` 的 stdio 实例行为完全不变;新键写错(变量名非法、用在 http 上、没有 auth、与 env 重名)按配置错误拒绝。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看：`packages/connectors/connector-mcp/src/mcp-provider.ts`(`credentialEnvOf`、stdio 分支合并 env)、`packages/connectors/connector-mcp/src/mcp-stdio-credential-env.test.ts`、`packages/lint/src/lint-connector-credential-literals.ts`(提示措辞)。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-stdio-credential-env.test.ts`,预期 17/17 通过(真实子进程只回报变量「已设置」和长度)。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes A declarative `provider: 'mcp'` instance over **stdio** can now take its credential from the secrets layer instead of a literal in `transport.env` (route (c), ruled by the seat on the card). - **Route.** The entry declares `auth: { type: 'bearer' | 'api-key' | 'basic', credentialRef }` exactly as an http instance does. The automation service resolves the reference through its existing chain (environment, then the stored connector credential, then the host resolver). The `mcp` provider then puts the resolved secret (the bearer token, the api-key key, or the basic password) into the child's environment under the variable that the new provider-owned key `providerConfig.transport.credentialEnv` names. `providerConfig` is provider-owned and untyped in the spec (ADR-0023), so there is no `packages/spec` hunk. - **Inherited for free.** All of this keys off `entry.auth`: Setup → Connector credentials lists the reference, a credential write re-materializes and re-spawns the instance, and a reference no arm answers degrades the instance naming the reference. That last case never calls the provider, so the server is never spawned. - **Where the value goes.** It only goes into the `env` handed to the spawn (the SDK's `StdioClientTransport` merges it over its default inherited set). It never goes onto the connector `def`, into a log, or into a message. A metadata read serves `auth.credentialRef` and `transport.credentialEnv`, which are two names; `transport.env` stays withheld whole, as before. - **Refusals.** These are configuration faults, thrown plain before anything is spawned, and none of them names a value: - a `credentialEnv` that is not an environment-variable name; - a `credentialEnv` on an http transport; - a `credentialEnv` with no static `auth` (absent, or `none`); - a `credentialEnv` naming a variable that `transport.env` also sets. A grant-bearing instance on stdio still meets the existing credential-handle refusal. That refusal's sentence now names this route (before, it pointed at "a static credential for the stdio one", which reached nothing). - **Unchanged (ruling Q2 A).** A stdio transport with no `credentialEnv` still does not apply `auth`. The silent drop is #29607. A stdio handshake does not count as the credential being sent (`credentialSent` / `credentialVerified` stay http-only). - **Advisory (#29341, `connector-credential-literal`).** The stdio env finding now steers to the route: "move it to the connector's `auth.credentialRef` with `transport.credentialEnv`". Its hint uses the same `auth: { type: 'bearer', credentialRef }` spelling as the header hint. The matching `os explain` paragraph is updated too. - **Pending release note corrected.** `.changeset/29341-connector-credential-literal.md` (the #29341 advisory's changeset, still pending on `main`) said that a stdio MCP server takes no `auth`, and steered authors to http. It would have shipped in the same release as this route. Its stdio bullet now names the `credentialEnv` route; this is a prose-only edit. `Check Changeset` / `check-empty-changeset` stays red on that file by design (the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class). The seat ordered the correction in the claim amendment on #29434. - **Docs.** In `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`, the stdio bullet now names `credentialEnv`, there is a new "A stdio server's credential" section with an `os:check` example, and the grant-bearing paragraph sentence is updated. **Forced test edits.** `packages/lint/src/lint-connector-credential-literals.test.ts` had two edits: - the stdio env message pin now names the new route (was: "a stdio server takes no `auth`; `auth.credentialRef` reaches it only over http"); - the `os explain` fact `A stdio MCP server takes no \`auth\`` is replaced by `A stdio MCP server takes the same \`auth\`` and `` `providerConfig.transport.credentialEnv` ``. One test was added in that file (the hint names the route with the shared spelling). ## Tests `packages/connectors/connector-mcp/src/mcp-stdio-credential-env.test.ts` (new, 17 tests). Every value in it is an obvious placeholder. - **Real spawns through the SDK.** The fixture child reports only whether the variable is set and its length, never the value. - bearer, api-key and basic each reach the child in the named variable, and the materialization carries no value; - control: the same instance with no `credentialEnv` starts the child without the variable; - control: a literal in `transport.env` reaches the child as today. - **Refusals.** Each of the four is thrown plain and names no value, and nothing is spawned (the not-a-name case is run with both a malformed string and a non-string). A grant handle on stdio meets the handle refusal, which now names `credentialEnv`. - **Metadata read.** The connector redactor serves `auth.credentialRef` and `transport.credentialEnv`, and `redactedKeys` is exactly `providerConfig.transport.env`. - **Through the automation service** (LiteKernel + AutomationServicePlugin + ConnectorMcpPlugin, a real stdio child): - a reference resolved by the host reaches the spawned server, and the served descriptor carries no value; - an unresolvable reference degrades the instance with `credential '…' is not set`, and the child's start marker is never written. - **Advisory.** The control (a literal in `transport.env` still draws the advisory) and the new wording are pinned in the lint test.
Ablations (each leg through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs: anchor 1→0, blob moved, then restored to blob == HEAD with an empty git diff HEAD; the suites import src, so no dist leg) - A1, the env merge dropped (`env: env`): 4 failed (bearer, api-key, basic, composition-resolved), `expected 'unset:0' to be 'set:28'`. - A2, the variable-name check dropped: 2 failed (not-a-name, not-a-string), `expected a throw`. - A3, the http refusal dropped: 1 failed (`credentialEnv on an http transport`). - A4, the no-auth refusal dropped: 2 failed (no auth: `TypeError` instead of the plain refusal; `none`: no throw). - A5, the clash refusal dropped: 1 failed (`sets environment variable … twice`). - A6, the old advisory steer restored: 1 failed (the stdio message pin, old vs new sentence).
## Acceptance notes - **Declaration and level:** `credentialEnv` is a key a metadata author writes, so the kind is `added` even with no spec hunk (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3; precedent PR #27387, `providerConfig.include` on `connector-openapi`). `@objectstack/connector-mcp` takes `minor`. `@objectstack/lint` changes only message text and stays `patch`. Both lines follow the seat's claim amendment on #29434. - **Review face:** `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --paths` on the final file list. Without the changesets it reads the declaration face, `TIER_DEFAULT`. With them it refuses and defers to the changeset's `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line, which is the same declaration face. - **Tool-list refusals over stdio** stay on the plain path. The seat confirmed option A: `credentialSent` / `credentialVerified` stay http-only. - **One secret per instance.** A server that reads two secrets keeps the second in `env`, or is declared as two instances. An `api-key`'s `headerName` / `paramName` are http placement and are not read on stdio. A `basic` username is not a secret, so it goes in `env` if the server reads it. - `protocol.ts` and every ADR are untouched. No ADR declares or rules out a stdio credential route. ADR-0024 §3 (credentials at the process/transport boundary) and ADR-0097 §3 (`credentialRef` resolved by the host) both hold as written. ## Verification Readings head: `f3ff3349` (merges `origin/main` `81cd9eb0`). Every reading below was taken on that head. The one commit after it, `a76ad3f8`, changes only the two changesets' prose and front matter, so no test, gate or dogfood reading was re-taken. On `a76ad3f8` the changeset gates ran as follows: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`, `check:issue-citations` and `check:nul-bytes` all exit 0. `check-empty-changeset` exits 1 on `.changeset/29341-connector-credential-literal.md`, the declared deliberate correction above.
Package suites and typecheck - `@objectstack/connector-mcp`: Test Files 9/9, Tests 119/119; typecheck exit 0 (incl. `check:test-typecheck`). - `@objectstack/lint`: Test Files 192/192, Tests 7892/7892; typecheck exit 0.
Full dogfood battery (credentials card) - Closure build `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` (plus the connector-mcp and lint closures) under the lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 68/68 tasks. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 398 passed and 3 skipped (401), Tests 3280 passed and 28 skipped (3308), 0 failed.
Derived gates - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 87 families derived on `f3ff3349`, all 87 run. - Three first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) and were re-run after their prerequisite, then exited 0: - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, after fetching its pinned fixture commit; - `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` (78/78 cache hits). - `--ran` reconciliation: `87 derived, 87 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a DERIVED zero). - `pnpm lint` (repo-wide eslint, `--no-inline-config`): exit 0. - CI families are not re-run locally; the PR check-runs are the record.
